mapper.select: SELECT C.BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE AS baseYearQuarterCode, C.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS adminDongCode, C.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE AS serviceIndustryCode, C.QUARTER_CODE AS quarterCode, C.OPERATING_STORE_COUNT AS operatingStoreCount, C.TOTAL_OPERATING_STORE_COUNT AS totalOperatingStoreCount, C.AREA_SIZE AS areaSize, C.OPERATING_FRANCHISE_STORE_RATIO AS operatingFranchiseStoreRatio, C.COMPETITION_DENSITY AS competitionDensity, C.FLOATING_POP_TOTAL_LOG AS floatingPopTotalLog, C.FLOATING_POP_PER_STORE AS floatingPopPerStore, C.YOUNG_POP_RATIO AS youngPopRatio, C.WEEKEND_POP_RATIO AS weekendPopRatio, C.AVG_MONTHLY_INCOME AS avgMonthlyIncome, C.FOOD_EXPENDITURE_RATIO AS foodExpenditureRatio, C.ENTERTAINMENT_EXPENDITURE_RATIO AS entertainmentExpenditureRatio, C.EDUCATION_EXPENDITURE_RATIO AS educationExpenditureRatio, C.LEISURE_EXPENDITURE_RATIO AS leisureExpenditureRatio, C.TOTAL_STORE_COUNT_CHANGE AS totalStoreCountChange, C.FLOATING_POP_CHANGE AS floatingPopChange, C.CLOSURE_RATE_CHANGE AS closureRateChange, S.SALES_LAG1_LOG AS salesLag1Log, S.SALES_LAG2_LOG AS salesLag2Log, S.SALES_LAG3_LOG AS salesLag3Log, S.SALES_LAG4_LOG AS salesLag4Log, S.SALES_MA2 AS salesMa2, S.SALES_MA3 AS salesMa3, S.SALES_STD2 AS salesStd2, S.SALES_STD3 AS salesStd3, S.SALES_GROWTH_RATE AS salesGrowthRate, S.SALES_TO_MA3_RATIO AS salesToMa3Ratio, S.SALES_CHANGE_RATE AS salesChangeRate, S.SALES_TO_INDUSTRY_AVG_RATIO AS salesToIndustryAvgRatio, S.FLOATING_POP_DENSITY AS floatingPopDensity, S.TOTAL_STORE_COUNT_LAG1 AS totalStoreCountLag1, S.TOTAL_POP_LAG1 AS totalPopLag1, S.COMPETITION_RATIO AS competitionRatio FROM REPORT_DATA_COMMON C JOIN REPORT_DATA_SALES S ON C.BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE = S.BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE AND C.ADMIN_DONG_CODE = S.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AND C.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE = S.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE WHERE C.ADMIN_DONG_CODE = #{adminDongCode} AND C.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE = #{serviceIndustryCode} ORDER BY C.BASE_YEAR_QUARTER_CODE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT base_year_quarter_code AS baseYearQuarterCode, pred_year_quarter_code AS predYearQuarterCode, admin_dong_code AS adminDongCode, service_industry_code AS serviceIndustryCode, pred_sales_per_store AS predSalesPerStore, segment AS segment, confidence AS confidence, top_sales_factors AS topSalesFactors, message AS message, sales_ai_response AS salesAiResponse FROM REPORT_DATA_PRED_SALES_RESULT WHERE base_year_quarter_code = #{baseYearQuarterCode} AND pred_year_quarter_code = #{predYearQuarterCode} AND admin_dong_code = #{adminDongCode} AND service_industry_code = #{serviceIndustryCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT_DATA_PRED_SALES_RESULT ( base_year_quarter_code, pred_year_quarter_code, admin_dong_code, service_industry_code, pred_sales_per_store, segment, confidence, top_sales_factors, message, sales_ai_response ) VALUES ( #{baseYearQuarterCode}, #{predYearQuarterCode}, #{adminDongCode}, #{serviceIndustryCode}, #{predSalesPerStore}, #{segment}, #{confidence}, #{topSalesFactors}, #{message}, #{salesAiResponse} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pred_year_quarter_code = VALUES(pred_year_quarter_code), pred_sales_per_store = VALUES(pred_sales_per_store), segment = VALUES(segment), confidence = VALUES(confidence), top_sales_factors = VALUES(top_sales_factors), message = VALUES(message), sales_ai_response = VALUES(sales_ai_response), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
